applications.name: Skope
applications.repo_description_en: Offline-first Wikidata scope explorer for Kristal. Search any QID, choose per-branch depth and relation filters, detect external convergence candidates, and export reproducible working graph snapshots. Generic Python/SQLite tool with external project recipes; no domain data or canonical promotion.
applications.scope_authority: application-owned local working recipe; no canon

applications.name: Kristal Iroquoiens Working
applications.repo_description_en: Working model for an Iroquoian-peoples Kristal anchored to Wikidata Q110654499. Owns scope recipes, editorial seeds, source archives, candidate axes, provenance and review workflows. Uses Skope as a separate generic tool to build an offline-capable non-canonical skeleton.
applications.scope_authority: editorial subject scope; working only, no canonical validation
applications.depends_on_tool: Skope via --recipe and --db; no copy of skope code

applications.name: Ekole
applications.repo_description_en: Curriculum-neutral learning engine for independent content packs. Provides local learner and teacher portals, an editor, and JSON APIs for course and pathway delivery.
applications.scope_authority: pack loading, learner and teacher applications

applications.name: Atelier Images
applications.repo_description_en: A local illustration studio for educational content. Generate batches with ComfyUI or Cloudflare, customize color palettes, compare results, and review, approve, and export illustrations for Ekole.
applications.scope_authority: draft prompts, palettes, generated illustrations and review decisions
applications.evidence_basis: Documented local project workflow and verified GitHub repository identity

applications.name: Ekole-Quebec
applications.repo_description_en: A primary education content pack for Ekole, aligned with Québec’s curriculum. It organizes learning goals, lessons, exercises, and themed activities into reusable Kristals for multilingual publishing.
applications.scope_authority: pack-owned educational content and authoring sources

applications.name: Ekole-Pastorale
applications.repo_description_en: An independent Catholic pastoral education content pack for Ekole. Includes French-language courses, pathways, and Kristal sources for Scripture, tradition, saints, virtues, and pastoral practice.
applications.scope_authority: pack-owned educational content and authoring sources

applications.name: kOA Digital Ecosystem
applications.repo_description_en: Cross-system architecture and integration map for kOA: ownership, versioned contracts, trust boundaries, maturity and release coordination across Kristal, EncyKlopedia, Da’at, UCKK, Koali and related applications including Skope and Ékole.
